source.title: La Primavera / Spring, RV 269 — II. Largo

bars.description: Only movement 2: bars 1–39 once in written order, with no pickup or repeat traversal. Returning material is written out in the source.

endpoints.basis: Initial score-pitch search windows from the cached recording analysis. Refine from endpoint pitch-energy evidence before publication; source-file tail or container duration is not the final musical attack.

provenance: The complete concerto archive is immutable; spring-score-1.mid and the spring2 source definitions select only movement 2. Its published MIDI contains 1042 sounding note attacks over 117 quarter-note units.

Source staves are solo violin, violin I, violin II, viola, and the written organ/cello bass line. Figured-bass symbols are retained visually but no realised continuo pitches or inferred separate double-bass part are invented. The source maintainer explicitly uses Anonymous.

The source cello/organ part explicitly reads Largo Tacet for all 39 bars and its MIDI track contains no notes; only the four sounding source string staves are included in this movement’s voice list and engraving.
